projects.title: AI Based Early Disease Prediction
projects.summary: Developing a multi-modal deep learning pipeline combining electronic health records and diagnostic imaging for premature pathology detection.
projects.description: This project addresses one of the critical challenges in healthcare: recognizing disease onset prior to acute clinical deterioration. We combine tabular clinical indicators with convolutional feature representations from imaging datasets. Students will experiment with attention-based neural architectures, interpretability mechanisms (SHAP, Grad-CAM), and model fairness validations.
objectives: Preprocess and normalize anonymized multi-source clinical telemetry datasets.
Train and validate transformer-based multimodal neural networks.
Produce clinical explanation heatmaps to aid physician interpretability.
Author a peer-reviewed research manuscript for an IEEE symposium.
projects.expectedOutcome: A deployable prototype web tool for hospital triaging and an indexed research paper.
projects.methodology: Iterative CRISP-DM methodology with bi-weekly sprints, reproducible Jupyter workflows, and continuous Git integration.

projects.title: Smart Agriculture Using IoT
projects.summary: Autonomous sensor mesh network for soil moisture, nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium tracking, and automated micro-irrigation.
projects.description: Modern agricultural efficiency hinges on precision water and nutrient management. In this research, we build an interconnected mesh of solar-powered ESP32 nodes communicating through LoRaWAN gateways to an edge processing station. Real-time telemetry predicts water deficit and triggers micro-valves.
objectives: Design energy-harvesting field sensor nodes with weather-sealed enclosures.
Deploy LoRaWAN packet forwarders and edge gateway MQTT telemetry.
Develop mobile-accessible telemetry dashboards with anomaly alerts.
projects.expectedOutcome: A field-tested automated irrigation controller and open dataset of soil moisture parameters.
projects.methodology: Hardware-in-the-loop rapid prototyping coupled with field trials at the university experimental farm.

projects.title: Secure Data Sharing in Cloud
projects.summary: Attribute-based encryption and homomorphic computation protocols for privacy-preserving collaborative cloud storage.
projects.description: Cloud storage multi-tenancy introduces severe corporate data breach vulnerabilities. This project introduces a hybrid cryptographic protocol: Ciphertext-Policy Attribute-Based Encryption (CP-ABE) augmented by zero-knowledge proofs to empower granular role-based file access without trusting storage providers.
objectives: Formulate security proofs under standard cryptographic assumptions.
Implement CP-ABE primitives using PBC (Pairing-Based Cryptography) library.
Benchmark computational overhead and decryption latency on mobile clients.
projects.expectedOutcome: An open-source cryptographic microservice SDK and comparative security analysis.
projects.methodology: Formal cryptographic threat modeling followed by performance stress-testing.

projects.title: Student Performance Analysis & Dropout Prediction
projects.summary: Predictive educational data mining leveraging learning management system engagement logs to identify students at risk.
projects.description: Educational inequality and high dropout rates in university introductory courses can be mitigated by timely academic interventions. We process clickstream logs, quiz submission patterns, and lab attendance metrics to train early-warning classification models.
objectives: Extract behavioral features from Moodle and Canvas database archives.
Train gradient-boosted decision trees (LightGBM, XGBoost) and recurrent networks.
Design an ethical advisory dashboard with bias mitigation safeguards.
projects.expectedOutcome: An institutional early-warning analytics service for PCIU academic counselors.
projects.methodology: Cross-validated time-series split with rigorous false-positive minimization.

projects.title: Blockchain for Academic Records & Credentials
projects.summary: Tamper-proof verifiable transcript verification system utilizing decentralized identifiers and smart contracts.
projects.description: Forged degree certificates undermine university credentials globally. By issuing transcripts as W3C Verifiable Credentials registered on an Ethereum-compatible Layer-2 blockchain, employers can verify student academic records in sub-seconds without contacting the university registrar.
objectives: Write and audit Solidity smart contracts for decentralized transcript anchoring.
Build a student wallet web application for sharing cryptographically signed certificates.
Deliver an instant QR-code credential verification portal.
projects.expectedOutcome: A live testnet decentralized application and institutional whitepaper.
projects.methodology: Hardhat development environment, OpenZeppelin contract standards, and end-to-end Cypress test suites.

projects.title: Renewable Energy Grid Optimization
projects.summary: Forecasting solar farm output and battery storage scheduling using deep reinforcement learning algorithms.
projects.description: Variable solar radiance introduces severe microgrid power fluctuations. In this project, we employ multi-agent reinforcement learning to orchestrate decentralized lithium-ion battery banks, minimizing grid curtailment while guaranteeing industrial power quality.
objectives: Model weather irradiance correlation using LSTM and neural prophet models.
Formulate Q-learning battery dispatch constraints for 100kW rooftop installations.
Simulate grid stability and economic cost savings over a 12-month period.
projects.expectedOutcome: A simulation framework and co-authored publication on green smart grids.
projects.methodology: Matlab Simulink combined with PyTorch reinforcement learning agents.

projects.title: IoT Based Smart Campus Management
projects.summary: Comprehensive classroom occupancy tracking, environmental air quality monitoring, and automated HVAC modulation.
projects.description: Transforming the Port City International University campus into an energy-efficient smart space through interconnected PIR sensor arrays, CO2 detectors, and automated scheduling relays.
objectives: Deploy sensor nodes across 20 university lecture halls and laboratories.
Feed metrics into a centralized MQTT message broker and time-series DB.
Produce measurable 25% energy savings through intelligent HVAC scheduling.
projects.expectedOutcome: Live operational campus management software and energy audit report.
projects.methodology: Agile milestone delivery coordinated with university facility management engineers.

projects.title: Quantum Resistant Cryptography on Embedded Devices
projects.summary: Benchmarking lattice-based post-quantum signature schemes (Dilithium, Kyber) on low-power ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers.
projects.description: With impending quantum computers capable of breaking RSA and ECC via Shor algorithm, post-quantum cryptography (PQC) must be ported to resource-constrained IoT silicon. We evaluate NIST PQC standardization winners on memory-restricted hardware.
objectives: Compile and profile Kyber and Dilithium reference implementations on Cortex-M4.
Optimize stack memory footprints and clock cycle overhead.
Measure side-channel power consumption resistance.
projects.expectedOutcome: Optimized C embedded library and benchmark paper in ACM transactions.
projects.methodology: Hardware profiling using oscilloscope power analysis and cycle-accurate emulators.

projects.title: Edge-AI Fall Detection & Vital Signs Monitoring
projects.summary: Real-time tinyML models running on wearable MCU sensors for geriatric fall detection and heart rate anomaly warning.
projects.description: Elderly care monitoring requires continuous low-latency edge inference without streaming sensitive camera or accelerometer feeds to the cloud. We design quantized convolutional neural networks deployed onto ARM Cortex microcontrollers with BLE alert broadcasting.
objectives: Collect and annotate tri-axial inertial measurement unit (IMU) fall datasets.
Quantize and prune deep neural models down to sub-100KB SRAM footprints using TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers.
Deploy and validate zero-false-positive alerts in clinical mock apartments.
projects.expectedOutcome: A validated wearable prototype, firmware repository, and co-authored manuscript.
projects.methodology: Iterative hardware-in-the-loop validation with stratified cross-validation.

papers.title: Deep Learning Architectures for Early Detection of Pulmonary Nodules in CT Scans
papers.abstract: Early detection of pulmonary malignancies drastically improves patient five-year survival prognoses. This study investigates 3D Convolutional Residual Networks coupled with spatial self-attention modules on the LIDC-IDRI lung cancer imaging database. Our proposed dual-path architecture achieves a sensitivity of 94.6% at 1.0 false positives per scan.
papers.citationsAPA: Rahman, F., Ketchum, A., & Sarhan, M. (2026). Deep Learning Architectures for Early Detection of Pulmonary Nodules in CT Scans. IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering, 73(4), 1012-1025.
papers.citationsIEEE: F. Rahman, A. Ketchum, and M. Sarhan, "Deep Learning Architectures for Early Detection of Pulmonary Nodules in CT Scans," IEEE Trans. Biomed. Eng., vol. 73, no. 4, pp. 1012–1025, 2026.

papers.title: IoT Sensor Mesh Optimization for Precision Agriculture in Subtropical Climates
papers.abstract: Subtropical monsoon microclimates demand resilient wireless telemetry capable of operating despite dense canopy attenuation. We present an adaptive duty-cycle LoRaWAN protocol that throttles transmissions based on dynamic soil hygrometer variance.
papers.citationsAPA: Sarhan, M., & Harrison, B. (2026). IoT Sensor Mesh Optimization for Precision Agriculture. In Proceedings of the ACM International Conference on Embedded Networked Sensor Systems (pp. 45-56).
papers.citationsIEEE: M. Sarhan and B. Harrison, "IoT Sensor Mesh Optimization for Precision Agriculture," in Proc. ACM SenSys, 2026, pp. 45–56.

papers.title: Zero-Knowledge Proofs for Cloud Identity Governance in Academic Institutions
papers.abstract: Decentralized identity protocols eliminate single points of failure in federated single-sign-on architectures. We formalize a zk-SNARK scheme that allows university students to verify laboratory authorization without disclosing personal identity identifiers.
papers.citationsAPA: Hossain, N., & Islam, S. (2026). Zero-Knowledge Proofs for Cloud Identity Governance. Computers & Security, 128, 102891.
papers.citationsIEEE: N. Hossain and S. Islam, "Zero-Knowledge Proofs for Cloud Identity Governance," Computers & Security, vol. 128, p. 102891, 2026.
